validation.thresholds_source: Fixed before training; no threshold tuning is scheduled

budget.extension_policy: No automatic extension. Any extension must be recorded with validation-only evidence and remaining time, never test results.
budget.memory_failure_policy: Preserve the failed smoke record, lower the short-side/long-side target or train fewer backbone layers, record the reason, and rerun smoke before real training.
budget.test_policy: No test dataset/list/images/annotations are loaded by training, augmentation, validation or checkpoint selection.
budget.pretrained_weights: Torchvision COCO Mask R-CNN ResNet50-FPN; both prediction heads replaced for background plus calculator
